name: ai-doc-assistant
description: Ask questions about your company documents and get answers with sources, powered by Claude.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
